description: Canonical metadata for a game achievement, published in the game's own AT Protocol repository.

main.description: Defines one achievement offered by a game. Publish in the game publisher's repository using a stable, human-readable slug rkey (e.g. `first-flight`, `score-50`). For spoiler-sensitive secrets (`hidden: true`), `title`, `description`, and `icon` MAY be omitted from the public PDS stub and revealed via an access-controlled ATProto Space (`hiddenSpace`) granted upon unlock.

game.description: AT-URI of the game definition record (e.g. `games.atmosphere.define` or `games.gamesgamesgamesgames.game`) in the publisher's repository.

title.description: Display name of the achievement (e.g. `Sky Surfer`). Required for visible (`hidden: false`) achievements; may be omitted on redacted public stubs when `hidden: true`.

description.description: Concise description of the achievement (earned summary or general explanation). May be omitted on redacted public stubs when `hidden: true`.

requirement.description: Optional imperative prompt shown BEFORE the player unlocks the achievement (e.g. `Clear 50 posts in a single run`), when `description` is written in the past tense (`You cleared 50 posts!`).

icon.description: Square icon representing the unlocked achievement (512x512 PNG or WebP with alpha transparency recommended). May be omitted on redacted public stubs when `hidden: true`.

iconAlt.description: Accessibility alt text for the achievement icon.

lockedIcon.description: Optional distinct icon shown while the achievement is locked (or as the public silhouette on a redacted `hidden: true` stub). If omitted, clients render a dimmed/grayscale treatment or generic lock badge.

tier.description: Optional trophy plaque tier indicating author-intended difficulty/prestige.

hidden.description: If true, clients MUST mask the achievement's title, description, and icon until the viewing player has unlocked it. To prevent firehose/`pds.ls` spoiler leaks, publishers MAY omit plaintext `title`/`description`/`icon` on the public PDS record and point `hiddenSpace` to an access-controlled ATProto Space that auto-adds players upon unlock.

hiddenSpace.description: Optional URI of an access-controlled ATProto Space (or reveal endpoint) holding the unredacted `achievement.definition` metadata for players who have unlocked this hidden achievement.

stepsNeeded.description: When present, marks this as an Incremental Achievement requiring `stepsNeeded` cumulative steps to unlock (enabling progress bars like `42 / 100`). Omit for standard single-step achievements.

group.description: Optional category, DLC pack, or family heading used to group related achievements.

listOrder.description: Optional sort index controlling the display order of locked achievements for this game.

badge.description: Optional AT-URI linking to a corresponding `community.lexicon.badge.definition` record (e.g. for cross-displaying a game's 100% Platinum milestone in general ATProto badge drawers).

trustedIssuers.description: Optional list of additional DIDs authorized to sign unlock attestations for this achievement (e.g. federated tournament hosts or post-EoS community revival servers).

createdAt.description: Timestamp when this achievement definition was created.

updatedAt.description: Timestamp when this achievement definition's presentation metadata was last updated.
